text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm waiting outside for Sakura
Chiyono
O to finish shopping at a
convenience store.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the wait! Thanks for coming
with me
today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yep! I got an animal sticker!
choice_data_list: 目当てのものは買えた？
choice_data_list_en: Did you find what you were looking to buy?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! My little sister and I have been
collecting
them recently.
choice_data_list: アニマルちゃんシール？

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
They come free with certain drinks and
have
educational animal trivia facts on
them! But best
of all, the designs are
really cute!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My older brother has been helping us
collect
them, so we've got almost all of
them now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All we're missing is the pronghorn
antelope, the
dolphin, and the cheetah.
I hope I get one of
them this time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O quickly opens the
package in
her hand and pulls out a
sticker from it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's the pronghorn antelope! Yay!
Look how
cool it is!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... "The pronghorn antelope has

extraordinary stamina. It can't outrun a
cheetah in
short sprints, but over long
distances, it's the
clear winner!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see. It make sense that some animals
are more
suited for short distances, while
others are better
at long distances.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It reminds me of the saying, cherry
blossoms
thrive in the mountains, and
seaweed in the sea.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Check out those horns, too. I wish I
could see how
they look in real life.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! How about we go to see them
together
sometime?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I hope there are antelopes at the
zoo near
us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, Sakura Chiyono O is over
the moon
after getting a sticker she
wanted.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's the dolphin! Aw, it's so cute!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The fun fact says, "Dolphins are aquatic
mammals
that live in groups. They're fast
swimmers and are
rumored to be very
intelligent!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Interesting. Actually, I remember going
to an
aquarium to see a dolphin show
with my family
when I was a kid.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It was super cool. They jumped so high
up, it
looked like they were flying!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So they're fast swimmers and smart, huh?
They're
like that saying! All-rounders
make great
entertainers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry. Give me just a second...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hello? What's up? Okay...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
T-T-Trainer, you won't believe it! That
was my
sister just now...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And she said she just got a dolphin
sticker right
now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
This is unbelievable! It's like my proverb
linked us
together! Dolphins really are
great entertainers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure why, but Sakura
Chiyono O is
especially motivated by
the dolphin sticker and
throws herself
into her training that day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's the cheetah! This is great. My
sister
wanted this one.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The cheetah's acceleration force is
unrivaled and
it's a champion at sprints.
With a great sense of
style, the cheetah
is one cool cat!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You do see lots of videos of cheetahs
running at
incredible speeds, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I could run that fast on the final
stretch,
nobody would stand a chance
against me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Like they say, the shortest way to victory
is
having a great weapon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding, ding, ding! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh? My siblings are blowing up our
group LANE
chat. I wonder what's up?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
They said they just got the pronghorn
antelope
and dolphin stickers!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, could it be? That means we have
the full
set! This is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I have to let them know right away! Um...
"I
actually just got the cheetah..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon after sending the message, Sakura
Chiyono
O gets a phone call from her
little sister, who is
extremely excited.
